461:t_2:36.en:
$$赤木$$
「I don't know what happened to you after we parted ways.」

461:t_2:37.en:
$$赤木$$
「But I know who you are now. And I know you can still change from here.」

461:t_2:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「It's been a while since you smiled.」

461:t_2:40.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then let's get something to eat. We'll invite $$カヲル$$, $$レイ#pt394$$ and the others too.」

461:t_2:42.en:
$$シンジ$$
(A home I will never return to...)

461:t_2:43.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I... wonder if I can find a new place to live...)

461:t_2:47.en:
$$甲児$$
「...I see. So $$宗介$$ visited $$陣代高校$$ after the $$時空震動$$...」

461:t_2:48.en:
$$風間$$
「Yeah... We heard about everyone in the $$ボランティア部$$ then too.」

461:t_2:49.en:
$n
「I was wrong to lie to all of you...」

461:t_2:50.en:
$$恭子$$
「Right after the incident, everyone was angry that you'd deceived us...」

461:t_2:51.en:
$$風間$$
「But once some time passed and we calmed down, we became more worried about you than angry.」

461:t_2:52.en:
$$詩織$$
「We also started to understand how much trouble Earth was in.」

461:t_2:53.en:
$$風間$$
「You were fighting for us through all of that.」

461:t_2:54.en:
$n
「That doesn't change the fact that we lied to our friends...」

461:t_2:57.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...It's not like you guys to talk that way.」

461:t_2:59.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Fighting to protect us makes up for lying to us.」

461:t_2:63.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「But... what else can we do?」

461:t_2:67.en:
$n
「But... if you'll let me, I want to bring peace back and return to $$陣代高校$$...」

461:t_2:69.en:
$$恭子$$
「$$小野Ｄ$$...! You shouldn't put it like...」

461:t_2:70.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「What's there to allow or not allow? Of course students come to school!」

461:t_2:72.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Tell $$相良$$, $$アルト$$ and the others too. I... want everyone in Class 2-4 to graduate together, especially in a world like this.」

461:t_2:73.en:
$$詩織$$
「Tell $$カレン$$, $$さやか$$ and the others too.」

461:t_2:75.en:
$$恭子$$
「$l... Your smile looks more natural now.」

461:t_2:76.en:
$$風間$$
「Yeah. You were almost scary when we first met.」

461:t_2:78.en:
$n
「Next time I come to see you, I'll bring $$千鳥$$, $$宗介$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$... I'll do everything I can to make that happen.」

461:t_2:81.en:
$$詩織$$
「Isn't there... something we can do...?」

461:t_2:82.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「...Is waiting all we can do...?」

461:t_2:83.en:
$$風間$$
「But... I think we can at least cheer them on...」

461:t_10:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$万丈$$... Are humans really such evil creatures?」

461:t_10:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ワッ太$$ and $$勝平$$ believe humans are wonderful, but I've seen so many villains.」

461:t_10:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「People who deceive others for their own desires, people who casually kill for their goals... So...」

461:t_10:9.en:
$$万丈$$
「But you believe in humans. That's why you can fight with $$鉄人$$.」

461:t_10:11.en:
$$万丈$$
「They can become good or evil... Humans and $$鉄人$$ are alike that way.」

461:t_10:12.en:
$$万丈$$
「Instead of $$鉄人$$'s remote control, humans have their own will. That determines how they live.」

461:t_10:13.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Do you believe in humans too, $$万丈$$?」

461:t_10:14.en:
$$万丈$$
「...Sadly, I've become a little tainted... So I can't easily say I believe in them.」

461:t_10:15.en:
$$万丈$$
「But I think good people and bad people alike are human. I won't obey a machine that lumps them all together and tries to destroy them.」

461:t_10:16.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, $$万丈$$. I feel... a little better now.」

461:t_10:17.en:
$$万丈$$
「Lean on the adults once in a while, $$正太郎$$. I'd like to think I'm at least dependable enough for that.」

461:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Their strong light withstood the $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$'s words and produced $$Ｚチップ$$s.)

461:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The amount... 100 Z... I'll add it to the team's stock.)

461:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Moonlight illuminates the dark, but where will the sun lead humanity...?)

461:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$赤木$$. You've had quite a time of it.」

461:t_10:27.en:
$$赤木$$
「I never paid much attention before, but it's nerve-racking when meeting the budget depends directly on you.」

461:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is the arrogance of a big company.」

461:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Look at $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. The President, Executive Director and Managing Director are always struggling to make a profit.」

461:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Being a hero of justice is fine, but as a company employee, you must be more rigorous in pursuing profits.」

461:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No excuses! If $$２１世紀警備保障$$ goes bankrupt, you won't be able to use $$ダイ・ガード$$ either!」

461:t_10:34.en:
$$赤木$$
「We can't afford that in this situation!」

461:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To remedy your lack of cost awareness, I'll put you through the same program used to train new $$ＤＥＭ$$ employees.」

461:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Rule one! New employees do physical work! Rule one! New employees take the initiative to speak up!」
